primary_claim: A 32B open-source model (Qwen2.5-Coder-32B) that at first appears unable to introspect on injected concepts actually shows subtle logit-level introspection, and this signal is massively amplified (e.g. 'yes' token probability shifting from +0.372% to +52.344% on injection) by providing the model with informative prompting about introspection.

effect.metric: 'yes' token probability shift upon concept injection (logit diff)
effect.value: inject 'cat', no info prompt: 0.150% -> 0.522% (+0.372%); inject 'cat', with info prompt: 0.757% -> 53.125% (+52.344%)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Qualifies Anthropic's introspection result (shown primarily in Claude Opus 4/4.1) by showing a much smaller 32B open-source model also introspects, just far more subtly than naive prompting would reveal
limitations_stated: Logit lens may not be picking up earlier-layer signals of introspection
Model mostly struggles to report the content of injected concepts, not just detect their presence (weak signals only)
Little success getting reports of injection content for the emergent-misalignment vector/finetune injections
quote: By looking at the logits, we show that a 32B open-source model that at first appears unable to introspect actually is subtly introspecting.
